review_evidence: README says the project exists to show off the Lean SDL3 bindings; the primary tree is the game/application source plus package/executable configuration.

All five primary files were inspected. Engine.lean implements Flappy-Bird-style rendering, collision/physics, input/audio and the game loop; Main.lean runs it; Basic.lean is only def hello := "world"; LeanSdlTest.lean is an import root; lakefile.lean copies assets/builds the executable.
A complete proposition scan found zero theorem, lemma, example, or axiom declarations.
